description: CutRoom delivery evaluation dataset covering 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31. Fully synthetic; see evidence/coverage.md.

sources.description: Procedurally generated studio history (2025-01..2026-12) from an authored episode plan, plus the authored CutRoom evaluation fixtures. No real people, channels or external records.

parameters.cadence: up to two planned episodes a month on varying days; release 6-11 days after kickoff at varying times, plus authored delays

load_clock.rule: env.load_seed rejects (invalid_seed) a virtual_now earlier than any stored past fact (published_at, note at/resolved_at, A/B result at, guest and license history, override at). Schedules and license expiries are plans and may point forward.

review.notes: Independent human review of realism and provenance pending.
